scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=path.join('.open-next');const assets=path.join(root,'assets');const nextStatic=path.join('.next','static');const publicDir=path.join('public');const mdDir=path.join('md');const workerSrc=path.join(root,'worker.js');const workerDest=path.join(root,'_worker.js');const copyDir=(src,dest)=>{if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});}};const copyEntry=(src,dest)=>{const stat=fs.statSync(src);if(stat.isDirectory()){copyDir(src,dest);}else{fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);}};if(fs.existsSync(workerSrc)){fs.copyFileSync(workerSrc,workerDest);}if(fs.existsSync(assets)){for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(assets)){copyEntry(path.join(assets,entry),path.join(root,entry));}}if(fs.existsSync(nextStatic)){copyDir(nextStatic,path.join(root,'_next','static'));}if(fs.existsSync(publicDir)){for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(publicDir)){copyEntry(path.join(publicDir,entry),path.join(root,entry));}}if(fs.existsSync(mdDir)){copyDir(mdDir,path.join(root,'md'));copyDir(mdDir,path.join(root,'server','md'));}fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'_routes.json'),JSON.stringify({version:1,include:['/*'],exclude:['/_next/static/*','/favicon.png','/robots.txt','/sitemap.xml']},null,2));"
scripts.build:pages:cf: npm run generate:md && opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run postbuild
scripts.preview:pages:cf: npm run build:pages:cf && wrangler pages dev .open-next --compatibility-date=2026-03-18 --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat
scripts.deploy:pages:cf: npm run build:pages:cf && wrangler pages deploy .open-next --compatibility-date=2026-03-18 --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat
